evals.prompt: 我刚 clone 了一个新项目，帮我看看怎么组织一下文档结构
evals.expected_output: 应该检测到没有记忆体系，主动提议初始化分层记忆结构
扫描项目结构，识别需要 memory.md 的目录，创建分层记忆文件

evals.prompt: 我新增了一个 packages/server/src/aila_server/agents 模块，需要更新记忆吗
evals.expected_output: 根据记忆更新策略，指导用户创建新模块的 memory.md 并更新父级索引

evals.prompt: I just cloned a new project, can you help me organize the documentation?
evals.expected_output: Should detect no memory structure exists and proactively propose initializing a layered memory system

evals.prompt: Set up a memory structure for this project
evals.expected_output: Scan project structure, identify directories that need memory.md, and create layered memory files

evals.prompt: I added a new module at packages/server/src/aila_server/agents, should I update the memory?
evals.expected_output: Follow the memory update strategy to guide user in creating a new module memory.md and updating parent indexes

evals.prompt: How should I document my project so AI can understand it better?
evals.expected_output: Should detect no memory structure and suggest initializing the layered memory system with memory.md and technology.md
Ask about language preference, identify project type, scan structure, and create the full memory hierarchy

evals.prompt: 帮我给一个复杂项目建立项目记忆。项目里有 src/workflow/nodes/conditions、src/workflow/nodes/actions、src/workflow/runtime、src/auth/providers、src/auth/policies 等多层业务目录，哪些层需要 memory.md 你自己判断。
evals.expected_output: Should propose a recursive memory tree instead of a fixed-depth layout, explain why each candidate directory does or does not need memory.md, and allow deeper directories such as src/workflow/nodes/conditions to have their own memory.md when complexity justifies it

evals.prompt: 更新已有记忆时，父级 memory.md 应该怎么写？我不想根 memory.md 里塞满 workflow/nodes/conditions 的业务细节。
evals.expected_output: Should state that parent memory files store only current-layer facts and next-layer indexes, child or grandchild implementation details belong in their own lower-level memory.md, and updates should target the nearest relevant layer before updating parent indexes

evals.prompt: 我想知道 workflow 模块有哪些记忆文档，不要从根目录一层层读，帮我快速定位。
evals.expected_output: Should use or recommend the bundled list-memory.js script with a workflow filter to return exact memory.md paths instead of manually traversing and reading many files

evals.prompt: 我要改 src/workflow/nodes/conditions/rule.ts，开发前应该读哪些 memory.md？
evals.expected_output: Should use or recommend find-memory.js for the changed file path, then read only the returned memory chain and update the nearest relevant memory.md after the change

evals.prompt: 我在 Codex 里使用这个 skill 初始化项目记忆，应该更新哪个入口文件？
evals.expected_output: Should use AGENTS.md for Codex, avoid creating CLAUDE.md by default, and keep memory.md and technology.md agent-neutral

evals.prompt: 这个项目同时有 CLAUDE.md 和 AGENTS.md，我现在用 OpenCode 修改记忆入口。
evals.expected_output: Should update AGENTS.md for OpenCode, preserve CLAUDE.md unless cross-agent synchronization is explicitly requested, and keep shared memory files agent-neutral

evals.prompt: 我用的 agent 你不认识，但我想初始化项目记忆。
evals.expected_output: Should ask which project-level instruction file the unknown agent uses instead of guessing CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, or another filename

Should treat this as a skill-recognized command-style prompt, not assume it is a host-registered slash command, and execute the init workflow from commands/init.md: detect existing memory with list-memory.js, identify the agent config file, propose a recursive memory tree, create memory.md/technology.md files, and write project memory prompt instructions into the agent config file

Should treat this as a skill-recognized command-style prompt, not assume it is a host-registered slash command, and execute the local update workflow from commands/update.md: use find-memory.js for the path, read only the returned memory chain, update the nearest relevant memory.md, and update parent indexes only when needed

Should treat this as a skill-recognized command-style prompt, not assume it is a host-registered slash command, and execute the full audit workflow from commands/update.md: list all memory.md files with list-memory.js, audit paths and parent-child boundaries, update stale entries, and preserve prompt instructions in the agent config file

evals.prompt: 这个 skill 是全局安装的，在项目里查询记忆时可以省略 --root 吗？
evals.expected_output: Should state that bundled memory scripts require an explicit --root <project-root>, must not rely on the current working directory, and should refuse to run without --root to avoid scanning memory files outside the target project
